data.name: Isa
data.gender_notes: Isa is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Yeshua (Jesus), from the root y-sh-ʿ, 'to save'. Its root is Hebrew y-sh-ʿ. The prophet ʿĪsā (Jesus), son of Maryam, in the Qur'an. Isa is a Arabic name meaning “God is salvation”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Isa expresses “God is salvation”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The Arabic form of the Hebrew Yeshua (Jesus), from the root y-sh-ʿ, 'to save'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Isa total 11, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
